item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, expect mostly cloudy to overcast skies with a chance of rain and low temperatures ranging from the mid-forties to the upper forties across the region. Saturday brings cloudy to mostly cloudy conditions with rain likely, and highs from the mid-fifties to the upper fifties. Rain continues Saturday night with lows in the mid-thirties to upper thirties, and precipitation amounts could reach up to half an inch in some areas.
